run_sam2_vrs_annotation: run the SAM2 video object annotation demo on a VRS file with interactive point prompts
extract_images_from_vrs: extract images from a VRS file into chunked folders using the extract_images function
get_clicked_points: get user-clicked points and labels from an image using OpenCV mouse interaction
process_video_with_sam2: process a video directory with SAM2 predictor to generate 2D bounding boxes and masks
visualize_sam2_results: visualize SAM2 segmentation results by rendering masks and bounding boxes on video frames
